tagline.en: From Peace Corps math teacher to the man who put television on the internet, now giving the fortune away
tagline.zh: 从和平队的数学老师到把电视搬上互联网的人，如今正把财富捐出去

label.en: Pure Software-era wealth, then wealth outside Netflix (cash from share sales, Powder Mountain, other holdings; estimate)
label.zh: Pure Software 时期的财富及此后 Netflix 以外的财富（售股所得现金、Powder Mountain 及其他资产，估算）

t.en: Boston to Swaziland
t.zh: 从波士顿到斯威士兰

desc.en: Grows up near Boston, studies mathematics at Bowdoin and teaches high-school math in Swaziland with the Peace Corps
desc.zh: 在波士顿一带长大，在鲍登学院读数学，随和平队到斯威士兰教中学数学

t.en: Pure Software
t.zh: Pure Software

desc.en: A Stanford computer science degree, a first startup that goes public, a merger and a sale to Rational
desc.zh: 拿到斯坦福计算机硕士学位，第一家创业公司上市、合并，最后卖给 Rational

t.en: DVDs by mail
t.zh: 邮寄 DVD

desc.en: Co-founds Netflix, switches it to subscriptions, is turned down by Blockbuster and takes the company public
desc.zh: 联合创办 Netflix，改为订阅制，被百视达拒绝收购，带公司上市

t.en: Streaming pivot
t.zh: 转向流媒体

desc.en: Launches streaming, writes the culture deck and nearly wrecks the brand with the 2011 price split and Qwikster
desc.zh: 推出流媒体，写下文化手册，又因 2011 年的拆分涨价和 Qwikster 差点毁掉品牌

t.en: Global studio
t.zh: 全球化与原创

desc.en: Original series, a launch in 130 countries in one day and a share price that multiplies many times over
desc.zh: 原创剧集、一天之内进入 130 个国家，股价翻了很多倍

t.en: Reset and handover
t.zh: 调整与交棒

desc.en: A subscriber loss and stock collapse, then ads, paid sharing and the handover of the CEO job
desc.zh: 用户流失、股价崩跌，随后是广告套餐、付费共享，以及交出 CEO 职位

t.en: Leaving Netflix
t.zh: 离开 Netflix

desc.en: Gives up his executive role, joins Anthropic's board, sees the Warner Bros. bid fail and leaves the Netflix board in June 2026
desc.zh: 卸任执行职务，加入 Anthropic 董事会，经历华纳兄弟收购落空，2026 年 6 月离开 Netflix 董事会

t.en: Born in Boston, Massachusetts
t.zh: 出生于马萨诸塞州波士顿

summary.en: Wilmot Reed Hastings Jr. was born in Boston, Massachusetts, and went to school in the Boston area.
summary.zh: 小威尔莫特·里德·哈斯廷斯出生在马萨诸塞州波士顿，并在波士顿一带上学。

why.en: Starting point, not scored. Human capital begins at the average level for a child born in the United States.
why.zh: 起点事件，不计分。人力资本以美国同龄人的平均水平作为初始值。

t.en: Graduates from Bowdoin College with a degree in mathematics
t.zh: 从鲍登学院毕业，获数学学士学位

summary.en: He finished a bachelor's degree in mathematics at Bowdoin College, a small liberal arts college in Maine. Decades later he became its largest donor.
summary.zh: 他在缅因州的文理学院鲍登学院读完数学本科。几十年后，他成了这所学校历史上最大的捐赠人。

why.en: An education step: the human-capital target rises. Only the year is confirmed, so the date is year precision.
why.zh: 学历台阶：人力资本目标值上调。只能确认年份，因此日期精度为“年”。

t.en: Teaches high-school math in Swaziland with the Peace Corps
t.zh: 随和平队到斯威士兰教中学数学

summary.en: After college he joined the Peace Corps and taught mathematics at a rural high school in northwest Swaziland (now Eswatini) from 1983 to 1985.
summary.zh: 大学毕业后他加入和平队，1983 至 1985 年在斯威士兰（今称埃斯瓦蒂尼）西北部的一所乡村中学教数学。

why.en: Almost no money involved. It is the root of his later focus on education, so the reputation coefficient gets a small +1%. The event is placed at the start year of his service.
why.zh: 几乎不涉及金钱。但这是他日后长期关注教育的起点，口碑系数小幅 +1%。事件放在服务开始的年份。

t.en: Earns a master's degree in computer science at Stanford
t.zh: 获斯坦福大学计算机科学硕士学位

summary.en: He completed a master's degree in computer science at Stanford University and went to work as a software engineer in Silicon Valley, first at Adaptive Technology, where he built a tool for debugging software.
summary.zh: 他在斯坦福大学拿到计算机科学硕士学位，随后在硅谷做软件工程师，先在 Adaptive Technology 工作，在那里做了一款调试软件的工具。

why.en: A strong technical degree in the right place: the human-capital target moves to about $1.5 million.
why.zh: 在对的地方拿到含金量高的技术学位：人力资本目标值上调到约 150 万美元。

t.en: Founds Pure Software, his first company
t.zh: 创办第一家公司 Pure Software

summary.en: He started Pure Software with Raymond Peck and Mark Box to sell tools that find bugs in programs. Revenue roughly doubled every year for its first four years, and he was chief executive from the start.
summary.zh: 他与雷蒙德·佩克、马克·博克斯一起创办 Pure Software，销售帮程序员查找程序错误的工具。头四年公司收入几乎每年翻一番，他从一开始就担任首席执行官。

why.en: First founder equity. The private anchor is a small estimate at this point; human capital starts climbing toward the level of a startup founder.
why.zh: 第一份创始人股权。此时的私有资产锚点只是很小的估算值；人力资本开始向“创业公司创始人”的水平爬升。

t.en: Pure Software goes public on Nasdaq
t.zh: Pure Software 在纳斯达克上市

summary.en: Pure Software listed on Nasdaq in August 1995 in an offering led by Morgan Stanley. It was his first experience running a public company.
summary.zh: 1995 年 8 月，Pure Software 在纳斯达克上市，由摩根士丹利担任主承销商。这是他第一次执掌上市公司。

why.en: His stake becomes liquid. The $30 million anchor is a rough estimate: his exact shareholding at the IPO is not in the sources used here.
why.zh: 他的股权有了流动性。3000 万美元的锚点只是粗略估算：本文所用资料中没有他上市时的确切持股数。

fin.zh: 估算个人财富：约 3000 万美元。

t.en: Pure Software merges with Atria Software to form Pure Atria
t.zh: Pure Software 与 Atria Software 合并为 Pure Atria

summary.en: Pure merged with Atria Software, a maker of version-control tools, and the combined company was named Pure Atria. Hastings stayed on as chief executive. He has since said that fast growth through acquisitions made the company slower and more bureaucratic.
summary.zh: Pure 与做版本管理工具的 Atria Software 合并，新公司取名 Pure Atria，哈斯廷斯继续担任首席执行官。他后来说过，靠并购快速扩张让公司变得迟缓、官僚。

why.en: Scored as mixed: a bigger company, but one he later described as a lesson in what not to do. The value is in the private anchors.
why.zh: 记为好坏参半：公司更大了，但他后来把这段经历当成反面教材。价值已体现在私有资产锚点里。

t.en: Rational Software completes its purchase of Pure Atria
t.zh: Rational Software 完成对 Pure Atria 的收购

summary.en: Rational Software bought Pure Atria in an all-stock deal announced in April 1997 and completed that summer. The shares of both companies fell sharply after the announcement, which cut the final price. Hastings became chief technical officer of the combined company and left soon afterwards.
summary.zh: Rational Software 以换股方式收购 Pure Atria，交易于 1997 年 4 月宣布，当年夏天完成。消息公布后两家公司股价都大幅下跌，最终成交价因此缩水。哈斯廷斯出任合并后公司的首席技术官，不久即离开。

why.en: The exit that paid for Netflix. Secondary sources put his proceeds at roughly $75 million; no primary figure was found, so the anchor (about $73 million after his first Netflix cheque) is an estimate. Netflix's prospectus dates the acquisition to August 1997; Rational's own filings give a closing date at the end of July.
why.zh: 这次退出为 Netflix 提供了启动资金。二手资料称他的所得约 7500 万美元；没有找到一手数字，因此锚点（扣除投给 Netflix 的第一笔钱后约 7300 万美元）是估算。Netflix 招股书写的是 1997 年 8 月被收购；Rational 自己的文件显示交割在 7 月底。

fin.en: Estimated personal wealth: about $75 million before funding Netflix.
fin.zh: 估算个人财富：投资 Netflix 之前约 7500 万美元。

t.en: Co-founds Netflix with Marc Randolph
t.zh: 与马克·伦道夫共同创办 Netflix

summary.en: Netflix was incorporated in Scotts Valley, California, by Hastings and Marc Randolph, who had worked for him at Pure Atria. Hastings supplied the early money and chaired the board while Randolph ran the company; the DVD rental website opened on April 14, 1998.
summary.zh: 哈斯廷斯和曾在 Pure Atria 为他工作的马克·伦道夫在加州斯科茨谷注册成立 Netflix。早期资金由哈斯廷斯提供，他任董事长，伦道夫负责日常经营；DVD 租赁网站于 1998 年 4 月 14 日上线。

why.en: The turning point of his life. A second private anchor starts for the pre-IPO Netflix stake, at about $2 million, roughly the amount he is reported to have put in (estimate).
why.zh: 人生转折点。模型从这一天起为上市前的 Netflix 股权单独设一条私有资产锚线，起点约 200 万美元，大致是据报道他投入的金额（估算）。

fin.en: Pre-IPO Netflix equity enters the model (estimated between funding rounds).
fin.zh: 上市前的 Netflix 股权进入模型（按各轮融资之间估算）。

t.en: As CEO, switches Netflix to a monthly subscription
t.zh: 出任 CEO 后把 Netflix 改为按月订阅

summary.en: Hastings had taken over as chief executive in September 1998. A year later Netflix introduced a flat monthly subscription for DVD rentals, and soon dropped single rentals and late fees altogether.
summary.zh: 哈斯廷斯于 1998 年 9 月接任首席执行官。一年后，Netflix 推出 DVD 租赁包月订阅，不久便彻底取消单次租赁和滞纳金。

why.en: The business model that defined the company. Its value shows in the later funding rounds and the IPO; a small +1% for the product decision.
why.zh: 这一商业模式定义了整家公司。价值体现在之后的融资和上市里；产品决策带来口碑系数小幅 +1%。

t.en: Appointed to the California State Board of Education
t.zh: 获任加州教育委员会委员

summary.en: Governor Gray Davis appointed him to the California State Board of Education in 2000, and he became its president in 2001. He also put $1 million of his own money into a ballot measure that made school bonds easier to pass. The state legislature declined to confirm him for a further term in 2005.
summary.zh: 2000 年，州长格雷·戴维斯任命他为加州教育委员会委员，2001 年他出任主席。他还自掏 100 万美元支持一项让学校债券更容易通过的公投提案。2005 年，州议会没有确认他连任。

why.en: A public role outside business that no valuation captures: +2% on the reputation coefficient. Only the year of the appointment is confirmed.
why.zh: 商业之外的公共职务，任何估值都反映不了：口碑系数 +2%。任命时间只能确认到年份。

t.en: Blockbuster turns down the chance to buy Netflix for $50 million
t.zh: 百视达拒绝以 5000 万美元收购 Netflix

summary.en: With the dot-com market falling and Netflix losing money, Hastings and Randolph offered to sell the company to Blockbuster for $50 million. Blockbuster's chief executive declined. Blockbuster filed for bankruptcy ten years later.
summary.zh: 互联网泡沫破裂、Netflix 仍在亏损之际，哈斯廷斯和伦道夫提出以 5000 万美元把公司卖给百视达，被对方首席执行官拒绝。十年后，百视达申请破产。

why.en: No money changed hands, so financial capital does not move. Scored as mixed at the time (a failed sale), but it became the best-known story about him, hence +2% on the reputation coefficient.
why.zh: 没有资金易手，金融资本不变。当时算好坏参半（一次没卖成的出售），但后来成了关于他最广为人知的故事，口碑系数 +2%。

t.en: Netflix lists on Nasdaq at $15 a share
t.zh: Netflix 以每股 15 美元在纳斯达克上市

summary.en: Netflix sold 5.5 million shares at $15 each, raising about $82.5 million. The prospectus shows Hastings holding 3,150,760 shares including options, or 14.8% after the offering.
summary.zh: Netflix 以每股 15 美元发行 550 万股，募资约 8250 万美元。招股书显示，哈斯廷斯连同期权共持有 3,150,760 股，发行后占 14.8%。

why.en: Anchor switch: from this day financial capital = ownership × shares outstanding × the daily close. The first ownership anchor is after the offering and counts his 600,000 options in full, because their exercise prices were very low; that puts his stake at about $47 million at the offer price. The prospectus is dated May 22 and trading began on May 23; some sources give May 29, the day the offering closed.
why.zh: 锚点切换：从这一天起，金融资本 = 持股比例 × 总股本 × 当日收盘价。第一个持股锚点取发行之后的比例，并把他的 60 万份期权全额计入（行权价很低），按发行价计算持股约值 4700 万美元。招股书日期为 5 月 22 日，5 月 23 日开始交易；部分资料写的 5 月 29 日是发行交割日。

fin.en: Priced daily from the NFLX quote from here on. Later ownership anchors come from the annual proxy statements.
fin.zh: 此后按 NFLX 日线逐日计价。之后的持股锚点取自历年股东大会委托书。

t.en: Netflix starts streaming films to subscribers' computers
t.zh: Netflix 开始向订户的电脑在线播放影片

summary.en: Netflix introduced a feature that let DVD subscribers watch about 1,000 titles instantly on a PC at no extra charge, rolled out over about six months. Hastings said the PC was only the first screen. In the same year he joined the board of Microsoft.
summary.zh: Netflix 推出新功能：DVD 订户可以在电脑上即时观看约 1000 部影片，不另收费，用大约半年时间分批开放。哈斯廷斯表示电脑只是第一块屏幕。同年他加入微软董事会。

why.en: The decision that made the company what it is. The financial result shows up in the share price over the following years; +3% on the reputation coefficient for moving before the DVD business had peaked.
why.zh: 这个决定造就了今天的 Netflix。财务结果体现在此后多年的股价里；在 DVD 业务还没见顶时就主动转型，口碑系数 +3%。

t.en: Publishes the Netflix culture deck
t.zh: 公开 Netflix 文化手册

summary.en: Hastings posted online a slide deck of about 125 pages that set out how Netflix manages people: high pay, wide freedom, candid feedback and generous severance for merely adequate performance. It was read millions of times and copied across Silicon Valley.
summary.zh: 哈斯廷斯把一份约 125 页的幻灯片放到网上，讲 Netflix 怎么管人：高薪、充分自由、坦率反馈，对表现仅仅合格的员工给予优厚的离职补偿。这份文件被阅读了数百万次，硅谷公司纷纷效仿。

why.en: A pure reputation event that no share price captures: +3% on the reputation coefficient. Sources agree on August 2009 but differ on the exact slide count.
why.zh: 纯声誉事件，股价反映不了：口碑系数 +3%。各方资料对 2009 年 8 月没有分歧，但对具体页数说法不一。

src.name: Netflix · Sharing our latest culture memo

t.en: Joins the board of Facebook
t.zh: 加入 Facebook 董事会

summary.en: Facebook named him a director a year before its IPO; he was already on Microsoft's board. He left the Facebook board in 2019, as the two companies increasingly competed in video.
summary.zh: Facebook 在上市前一年任命他为董事，当时他已是微软董事。2019 年他离开 Facebook 董事会，那时两家公司在视频领域的竞争越来越多。

why.en: A marker of his standing in the industry at the peak of the first streaming boom: a small +1%.
why.zh: 这是他在第一波流媒体热潮顶点时行业地位的标志：口碑系数小幅 +1%。

src.name: Meta Newsroom · Facebook names Reed Hastings to its board

t.en: Splits DVD and streaming into separate plans, a 60% price rise for many
t.zh: 把 DVD 和流媒体拆成两个套餐，许多用户涨价六成

summary.en: Netflix ended its combined plan and charged separately for DVDs by mail and for streaming, at $7.99 a month each. Customers who wanted both paid about 60% more, and many cancelled. The stock was at a record high that week.
summary.zh: Netflix 取消合并套餐，邮寄 DVD 和流媒体分开收费，各 7.99 美元一个月。两样都要的用户要多付约六成，许多人因此退订。那一周股价正处于历史高点。

why.en: The share price carries the financial loss. The -3% on the reputation coefficient is for the anger of customers, which was aimed at him personally. On the 2011 proxy figures his stake was worth roughly $700 million at the July peak (estimate; options counted at 70%).
why.zh: 财务损失由股价承担。口碑系数 -3% 来自用户的愤怒，而这种愤怒直接指向他本人。按 2011 年委托书的数字，他的持股在 7 月高点约值 7 亿美元（估算；期权按七成计入）。

t.en: Announces Qwikster, then cancels it three weeks later
t.zh: 宣布成立 Qwikster，三周后取消

summary.en: In a blog post that began with an apology, Hastings said the DVD service would become a separate company called Qwikster with its own website and billing. The plan was widely ridiculed and was dropped on October 10. Netflix lost about 800,000 U.S. subscribers that quarter, and the stock fell roughly 78% from its July high to the end of November.
summary.zh: 哈斯廷斯在一篇以道歉开头的博客里宣布，DVD 业务将独立成一家叫 Qwikster 的公司，网站和账单都分开。这个计划遭到普遍嘲笑，10 月 10 日即告取消。当季 Netflix 在美国流失约 80 万订户，股价从 7 月高点到 11 月底下跌约 78%。

why.en: The price collapse is in the stock. The business press named it one of the worst management mistakes of the year, which the price cannot fully see, so the reputation coefficient takes -5%. The decline figure is computed from the local price data.
why.zh: 股价的崩跌由股票自身反映。财经媒体把它列为当年最糟糕的管理失误之一，这是价格看不全的，因此口碑系数 -5%。跌幅根据本地价格数据计算。

t.en: “House of Cards” launches, the first Netflix original series
t.zh: 首部 Netflix 原创剧《纸牌屋》上线

summary.en: Netflix released all thirteen episodes of its first original series at once. The show had been ordered in 2011 without a pilot, a commitment that set the pattern for the company's move from distributor to studio.
summary.zh: Netflix 把第一部原创剧的十三集一次性全部放出。这部剧在 2011 年未拍试播集就直接订购，这一承诺为公司从发行方转向制片方定下了模式。

why.en: The recovery from 2011 is in the share price. The +4% on the reputation coefficient is for a bet that changed how television is made and released.
why.zh: 从 2011 年低谷的复苏已体现在股价里。口碑系数 +4% 是因为这次押注改变了电视剧的制作和发行方式。

t.en: Netflix shares start trading after a seven-for-one split
t.zh: Netflix 股票完成 1 拆 7 后开始交易

summary.en: Netflix announced a seven-for-one stock split in June 2015; the new shares were paid on July 14 and trading at the split-adjusted price began on July 15. An earlier two-for-one split took place in 2004.
summary.zh: Netflix 于 2015 年 6 月宣布 1 拆 7；新股于 7 月 14 日派发，7 月 15 日起按拆股后的价格交易。此前在 2004 年还有过一次 1 拆 2。

why.en: A split changes nothing in value: prices and share counts in the model are all on today's adjusted basis. Listed so that readers can reconcile old share prices.
why.zh: 拆股不改变价值：模型里的价格和股本都按今天的复权口径计算。列出此事是为了方便读者对照旧股价。

t.en: Starts a $100 million education fund
t.zh: 设立 1 亿美元教育基金

summary.en: He announced a $100 million fund for education, held at the Silicon Valley Community Foundation, with first grants for college scholarships. He had joined the Giving Pledge, a promise to give away most of his wealth, in 2012, and has long funded charter schools.
summary.zh: 他宣布设立 1 亿美元的教育基金，资金放在硅谷社区基金会，首批拨款用于大学奖学金。他在 2012 年加入“捐赠誓言”，承诺捐出大部分财富，并长期资助特许学校。

why.en: Money leaves his own balance sheet, which the outside-wealth anchors absorb. The reputation coefficient gets +3%. His support for charter schools is contested by teachers' unions and some education researchers.
why.zh: 这笔钱离开了他个人的资产负债表，已反映在 Netflix 以外财富的锚点里。口碑系数 +3%。他对特许学校的支持受到教师工会和部分教育研究者的质疑。

t.en: Switches Netflix on in 130 more countries during a keynote
t.zh: 在主题演讲中宣布 Netflix 新进入 130 个国家

summary.en: On stage at the Consumer Electronics Show in Las Vegas, Hastings announced that Netflix had just gone live in 130 additional countries, making it available almost everywhere except China. The stock rose about 9% that day.
summary.zh: 在拉斯维加斯消费电子展的讲台上，哈斯廷斯宣布 Netflix 刚刚在另外 130 个国家上线，除中国外几乎覆盖全球。当天股价上涨约 9%。

why.en: The price jump is carried by the stock. The +3% on the reputation coefficient is for turning a U.S. service into a global one in a single day.
why.zh: 股价的跳升由股票自身反映。口碑系数 +3% 是因为他在一天之内把一家美国公司变成了全球服务。

t.en: Gives $120 million to historically Black colleges
t.zh: 向传统黑人院校捐赠 1.2 亿美元

summary.en: Hastings and his wife Patty Quillin gave $40 million each to Spelman College, Morehouse College and the United Negro College Fund, mostly for scholarships. Each recipient called it the largest individual gift in its history.

why.zh: 损失已体现在股价里：他的持股从 2021 年高点的约 48 亿美元跌到 2022 年 5 月的约 11 亿美元（估算）。他坚持多年的战略受到质疑，口碑系数另扣 2%。

why.en: The value is in the share price. A small +1% for reversing a long-held position quickly once the facts changed.
why.zh: 价值已体现在股价里。事实变了之后迅速推翻自己坚持多年的立场，口碑系数小幅 +1%。
